title: Fortune Avenue
tagline: Roll In. Buy Big. Cause Chaos.

cards.title: Viral Overnight
cards.effect: Your strangest landmark goes viral. Collect 80.

cards.title: Scenic Shortcut
cards.effect: Move to any landmark in your current district.

cards.title: Tip Jar Overflow
cards.effect: Collect 20 from every other player.

cards.title: Tax Refund Confetti
cards.effect: Collect 100, then move forward 1 space.

cards.title: Grand Reopening
cards.effect: Choose one owned landmark. Double its entry fee until your next turn.

cards.title: Friendly Inspector
cards.effect: Remove one closure or penalty affecting you.

cards.title: Free Upgrade
cards.effect: Add one upgrade to an owned landmark at no cost.

cards.title: VIP Wristband
cards.effect: Keep this card. Ignore one entry fee, then discard it.

cards.title: Perfect Timing
cards.effect: Take another turn after this one.

cards.title: Neighborhood Grant
cards.effect: Collect 30 for each district where you own a landmark.

cards.title: Flash Sale
cards.effect: Your next unowned landmark costs 25 less this turn.

cards.title: Found Wallet
cards.effect: Collect 50. Sometimes the sidewalk provides.

cards.title: Influencer Visit
cards.effect: Choose an owned landmark. Collect 15 from every other player.

cards.title: Festival Sponsor
cards.effect: Move to Street Festival and collect 70.

cards.title: Midnight Pass
cards.effect: Move to either transport space. Do not pay an entry fee.

cards.title: Position Upgrade
cards.effect: Swap positions with any player. That player collects 20.

cards.title: Lucky Coin
cards.effect: Keep this card. Reroll one future movement roll, then discard it.

cards.title: Golden Hour
cards.effect: Entry fees paid to you are doubled until your next turn.

cards.title: Clean Inspection
cards.effect: Your next upgrade costs 20 less.

cards.title: Crowd Favorite
cards.effect: Move to your highest-value landmark and collect 40.

cards.title: Unexpected Inheritance
cards.effect: Collect 120, then pay 20 for each upgrade you own.

cards.title: Community Tip Jar
cards.effect: Collect 10 from each player. The bank matches the total.

cards.title: Big Break
cards.effect: Choose: collect 60, or move forward exactly 6 spaces.

cards.title: Fortune Smiles
cards.effect: Advance to Grand Entrance and collect the usual start bonus.

cards.title: Parade Blockade
cards.effect: Every player moves backward 3 spaces without resolving the destination.

cards.title: Surprise Inspection
cards.effect: Pay 20 or close one owned landmark until your next turn.

cards.title: Free Admission Day
cards.effect: Nobody collects entry fees until your next turn.

cards.title: Sudden Sinkhole
cards.effect: Move directly to Wrong Turn. Do not collect a start bonus.

cards.title: Review Bomb
cards.effect: Choose one owned landmark. Halve its entry fee until your next turn.

cards.title: Parking Disaster
cards.effect: Pay 30 for towing, cones, and emotional damage.

cards.title: Power Flicker
cards.effect: Move to Fortune Power & Light and resolve that space.

cards.title: Water Main Burst
cards.effect: Move to Avenue Waterworks and resolve that space.

cards.title: Wrong Address
cards.effect: Swap positions with the player on your left.

cards.title: Double Detour
cards.effect: Move to The Scenic Detour, then end your turn.

cards.title: Missing Permit
cards.effect: Pay 15 for every upgrade you own.

cards.title: Flash Flood
cards.effect: Close your lowest-value landmark until your next turn.

cards.title: Mystery Buyer
cards.effect: The bank immediately auctions one unowned landmark.

cards.title: Neighborhood Blackout
cards.effect: Choose one district. It collects no entry fees until your next turn.

cards.title: Weather Nonsense
cards.effect: Every player moves clockwise to the nearest corner and resolves it.

cards.title: Celebrity Entourage
cards.effect: The next visitor pays no fee. Collect 50 from the bank instead.

cards.title: GPS Glitch
cards.effect: On your next turn, move counterclockwise.

cards.title: Construction Season
cards.effect: Move forward 2 spaces, then end your turn without resolving the space.

cards.title: Steal a Landmark
cards.effect: Choose one rival landmark. Pay its owner what they paid, then take the deed.

cards.title: Lost Luggage
cards.effect: Pay 40, or move to The Midnight Express and end your turn.

cards.title: Festival Cleanup
cards.effect: Pay 10 for every landmark you own.

cards.title: Market Dip
cards.effect: Reduce every entry fee by 10 until your next turn; minimum 0.

cards.title: Sudden Rebrand
cards.effect: Choose one owned landmark. It collects no fee until you visit it.

cards.title: Final Twist
cards.effect: Roll one die: 1-3 pay 60; 4-6 collect 60.
